bottleneck.description: #2 pneumatic component supplier in China (~30% share) producing cylinders, valves, and FRLs; positioned as cost-disruptive alternative to SMC/Festo.

dependency.key_customers: Chinese automation system integrators, EV battery makers (CATL), packaging machine OEMs, semiconductor tool builders
dependency.key_suppliers: Aluminum extrusion mills, solenoid coil suppliers, seal/elastomer suppliers

editorial.notes: Airtac has gained share aggressively from Japanese pneumatics incumbents on price and now holds ~30% of China pneumatics, with plans to reach 33-35% by 2028-2030. However, the pneumatic component market is structurally competitive with SMC, Festo, Parker, CKD, and various Chinese players (Yadeke, etc.). Airtac is a strong margin operator but its product line is broadly substitutable, supporting LOW.
